# 🧩 Documentation Templates

Use these templates for new feature, architecture, testing, risk, incident, and release work. Replace all prompts and remove irrelevant sections before publishing. Never insert secrets or real financial information.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Decision Record](adr.md) | Capture a significant technical decision |
| [Feature specification](feature.md) | Define scope and acceptance criteria |
| [Bug report](bug-report.md) | Record a reproducible defect |
| [Test plan](test-plan.md) | Define verification and test evidence |
| [Risk register](risk-register.md) | Track security, privacy, and delivery risks |
| [Incident report](incident.md) | Document an incident and response |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Review a release candidate |
